According to the source [Just the Two of Us (Grover Washington Jr. song)], the edited version of "Just the Two of Us" reached number two behind "Bette Davis Eyes" by Kim Carnes.  
According to [Bette Davis Eyes], Kim Carnes's version spent nine weeks at No. 1 on the "Billboard" Hot 100.  
The song "Bette Davis Eyes" was written and composed by Donna Weiss and Jackie DeShannon, as stated in [Bette Davis Eyes] and [New Arrangement].

Final answer: nine
